title: Customer Signal Handshake & Roadmap Admission Gate
creator: Maya Singh
description: Define and ship a formal "handshake" protocol between Customer Success, Sales, and Product that converts high-intent account signals (escalations, strategic asks, renewals-at-risk) into a standardized roadmap admission decision. This ticket implements the operational gate, documentation, scoring heuristics, and short-term automation to speed decisions for top customers while preserving product strategy guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented admission checklist and signal enrichment spec exists in Confluence and is linked in the intake flow; 2) CS/Sales -> PM handoff Slack template + automated pre-fill form deployed; 3) A reproducible scoring heuristic (revenue-weighted + technical feasibility + strategic fit + risk) implemented as a spreadsheet and validated against a sample of 30 recent escalations with at least 80% agreement with historical outcomes; 4) Two-week pilot with three high-touch accounts completed and feedback captured; 5) A canary 'fast-pass' workflow for time-sensitive escalations (SLA <= 72 hours) implemented and operational metrics tracked; 6) Playbooks for fallback (defer, partial-scope, workaround) created and approved by PML and CS leaders.
notes: We are intentionally separating signal collection from admission decisions — signals are enriched (usage, calls, open bugs, renewal date) before being scored.
Scoring will be tuned to avoid purely revenue-chasing outcomes. Product strategy score will have explicit veto thresholds.
We will not auto-schedule roadmap commits; admission is a gating decision with optional timeboxed commitments recorded in the commitment ledger.
